title: Fundamentals of Wireless Communication (2005)
summary: A classic graduate-level textbook on wireless communication fundamentals by David Tse and Pramod Viswanath from Stanford University, covering topics including information theory, wireless channel modeling, MIMO, cellular systems, and advanced modulation techniques.
problem_solved: Provides comprehensive theoretical foundations for understanding, analyzing, and designing modern wireless communication systems.
why_valuable: This is one of the most influential and widely-adopted textbooks in wireless communications, serving as the standard reference for graduate-level courses on cellular systems and MIMO technology worldwide.
